icons.instructions: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke-width to 1.5 or 2 for clarity. Use standard icons (Users, FileText, AlertCircle, CheckCircle, Clock, Shield, Settings, LayoutDashboard, Download).

image_urls.description: Geometric building to serve as a placeholder company logo/login background.
Professional headshot for user avatars and manpower profile thumbnails.
Minimalist folder setup for empty states or document upload placeholders.

interactions.hover: Subtle background color changes for interactive elements (e.g., hover:bg-zinc-50). Ensure text contrast remains high.
interactions.focus: High contrast focus rings mandatory on all inputs and buttons: focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-zinc-900 focus-visible:ring-offset-1.
interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy transitions. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Zinc-500 is the lightest allowed text on white for small labels.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='approve-manpower-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install standard Shadcn components: table, button, input, badge, select, dialog, tabs.
Override default 'Inter' font with 'IBM Plex Sans' for body and 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings.
Implement the Layout with a Fixed Dark Sidebar (bg-zinc-900) and a Sticky White Header (bg-white).
For the Manpower Data Table, use a dense layout. Remove left/right borders on cells, use a subtle bottom border.
For IDs like Manpower ID, strictly wrap them in the 'id_number' formatting from the guidelines.
Use distinct status colors explicitly defined in the 'colors.status' and 'colors.documents' objects. Do not use generic colors.
Ensure the Medical Certificate renewal flow includes clear warnings (Expiring Soon) using the Orange-500 palette.
Never use placeholder URLs (like placehold.co). Use the provided image URLs in the media section.
Do not use card components heavily; use flat div containers with border-zinc-200 and shadow-sm for a clean, structural enterprise look.
Always apply data-testid attributes to CTAs, table rows, and form elements.
